reasons.plausibility: The oxide dispersion strengthening mechanism is well-established and logically extends to RHEAs under high-temperature and irradiation conditions.
reasons.testability: The proposed comparative experiment with baseline and oxide-doped samples provides a clear, decisive method to confirm or refute the improvement in mechanical and microstructural performance.
reasons.usefulness: Applying a proven strengthening method to a novel material system offers valuable insights and could significantly advance RHEA design for extreme environments.
